C: B2 [ C ] (a piece of) thin metal thread with a layer of plastic around it, used for carrying electric current
› US a secret recording device hidden worn by a person, especially one that is hidden in their clothes
› UK the wire fence around a prison or prison camp

T: › to send money using an electrical communication system
› mainly US in the past, to send someone a telegram

example: a wire fence
金屬線柵欄

無論如何都別碰那些導線。

戰爭期間他蹲了三年監獄。
